title: Gus and the Rock Cruncher
synopsis: At the stone yard viewing room, Gus sees heavy stone brought from a quarry to a crusher. The loud machine makes smaller pieces, and Gus considers whether a machine can really have a lunch.
continuity_state: Before: A small strip beside Pine Park gate needs fresh crushed stone after the thaw. Jack has asked where the stones come from; Aunt Jo has arranged an adult-guided look from the stone yard viewing room. After: The friends have met Mr. Fred, an adult badger managing the stone yard north of Pine Park. The viewing room looks onto the fenced industrial plant. Large stone arrives from a separate quarry by haul truck and goes through a primary crusher before moving onward by conveyor for sorting. No children entered work areas. The park strip remains unrepaired.
